video.script: Starting over? Don't erase what is working. Make three lists. What do I want to keep? What do I want to change? What can't I change this week? Then choose one small step you control. For example: tonight, compare three course schedules. Not, get a new job by Friday. Seven days is a planning window, not a promise of a new life. Open the free plan from our channel profile.
